Path 1 - Survey Methodology
  Path 1: Survey Methodology (Observational Research)

Best For: Measuring prevalence, attitudes, correlations.
Software: SPSS or Jamovi (Required)
Constraint: Focus on 2 to 3 Core Variables (IV/DV). Use existing, validated measures (no self-drafted questions).

Phase 1: Measure Selection & Review

Search: Find validated psychometric scales for your IV and DV.
Check Reliability: Look for Cronbach's Alpha (α ≥ 0.70).

Phase 2: Variable Mapping

Define Structure: Map scale items to SPSS/Jamovi variables.
Reverse Coding: Define value labels (e.g., 1=Never, 5=Always).

Phase 3: Ethics & IRB

Consent: Include purpose, voluntary nature, and anonymity.
Submission: Submit to IRB with copyright clearance.
Deliverable: IRB Approval Letter.

Phase 4: Sampling & Collection

Target: N≥30N \ge 30N≥30 (Correlation) or N≥100N \ge 100N≥100 (Regression).
Action: Distribute link; Monitor for straight-lining.
Deliverable: Raw Data Export (.CSV).

Phase 5: Data Analysis (SPSS/Jamovi)

Clean: Handle missing values (99/999).
Stat: Descriptive (Frequencies/Means) + Inferential (t-test/ANOVA/Correlation).
Deliverable: Statistical Output PDF.

Path 2 - Qualitative Interview
Path 2: Qualitative Interview Research

Best For: Exploring experiences, motivations, themes.
Software: NVivo or Manual Coding (Transcription) + SPSS/Jamovi (for Data Management only).
Constraint: Focus on 2 to 3 Core Research Questions/Themes.

Phase 1: Protocol Design

Guide: Create a Semi-Structured Interview Guide (10–15 open-ended questions).
Themes: Map questions to 2–3 Core Themes.
Deliverable: Interview Protocol.

Phase 2: Ethics & IRB

Consent: Must specify recording method (Audio/Video) and anonymity.
Video: Specific addendum for video consent.
Deliverable: IRB Approval Letter.

Phase 3: Sampling & Collection

Method: Purposive or Snowball Sampling (N=15–30N = 15–30N=15–30).
Recording: Record audio/video; Transcribe accurately.
Deliverable: Transcripts (Anonymized).

Phase 4: Analysis (Coding)

Code: Line-by-line coding or thematic analysis.
Output: Theme mapping with representative quotes.
Deliverable: Qualitative Analysis Report.

Path 3 - Experimental Design
Path 3: Experimental Design

Best For: Establishing causality, manipulation of variables.
Software: SPSS or Jamovi (Required for Analysis)
Constraint: Focus on 2 to 3 Core Variables.

Phase 1: Protocol & Deep Design

Manipulation: Define IV operationalization (Treatment Manual).
Control: Define Control Condition (Placebo/Waitlist).
Scripts: Create introduction/instruction/debriefing scripts.
Pilot: Conduct pilot test (N=3−5) to check feasibility.
Deliverable: Pilot Test Report & Experimental Protocol.

Phase 2: Ethics & IRB

Consent: Include group assignment details and debriefing for deception.
Deliverable: IRB Approval Letter.

Phase 3: Sampling & Collection

Assignment: Randomization Log (Coin flip or RNG).
Deliverable: Randomization Log & Raw Data.

Phase 4: Analysis (SPSS/Jamovi)

Tests: t-test, ANOVA, or Regression.
Assumptions: Check Normality/Homogeneity.
Deliverable: Statistical Output PDF.

Path 4 - Archival Data
Path 4: Archival/Secondary Data Analysis

Best For: Analyzing trends, secondary data, historical context.
Software: SPSS, Jamovi, R, or Python.
Constraint: Focus on 2 to 3 Core Variables from the Dataset.

Phase 1: Dataset Selection

Source: Public datasets (CDC, Census, etc.).
Feasibility: Check dictionary, access level, and NNN.
Deliverable: Dataset Evaluation Form.

Phase 2: Cleaning & Preparation

Plan: Handle missing values, deduplicate, standardize variable names.
Deliverable: Data Cleaning Plan & Cleaned Dataset.

Phase 3: Ethics & IRB

Status: Usually Exempt (No contact with subjects). - Still Need IRB Approval
Deliverable: IRB Approval Letter

Phase 4: Analysis

Tasks: Trends, Correlation, Regression.
Deliverable: Archival Analysis Report.
